name: Majorana Demonstrator
summary: The Majorana Demonstrator used ultralow-background germanium detector arrays at SURF. It searched for germanium-76 neutrinoless double-beta decay and demonstrated radiopure construction methods for LEGEND.
detection_principle: Enriched germanium diodes provide both the source and high-resolution calorimeter. Pulse-shape analysis rejects multisite energy deposits, while ultrapure copper and shielding reduce radioactive backgrounds.

status.label: Enriched-germanium double-beta search completed
status.evidence: The final enriched-detector search reported a half-life lower bound and demonstrated low backgrounds for future germanium arrays.

collaboration.name: Majorana Demonstrator Collaboration
collaboration.participants_note: Institutions listed here are selected documented participants; the official collaboration page provides the complete membership.

key_parameters.name: Detector mass
key_parameters.value: Up to 40.4 kg of detectors in the final search, including 27.2 kg enriched to approximately 88% in 76Ge

results.summary: The final enriched-detector search reported a half-life lower bound and demonstrated low backgrounds for future germanium arrays.

science_scope: A neutrinoless double-beta-decay signal would establish lepton-number violation. Converting a half-life constraint into an effective Majorana mass requires a decay mechanism and nuclear matrix elements; a null search is not a neutrino-mass measurement.
